notes.title: Announcing the release date + pricing
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The Steam Next Fest is about to begin, I hope you will have fun playing the Eggy demo! As promised I will reveal the launch date and pricing. Drum rolls please......

The game will launch on July 21st 2021 and will cost 11 dollars (pricing will vary depending on your country)

On launch day there will be a 20% discount, wishlist the game so you will get notified when Eggy releases.

Have a nice day! :)
